status: FROZEN before any matrix run; thresholds are not changed after results are seen
scope: Offline software matrix with a deterministic stand-in Hypothesis Engine (tests/g0_standin.py). It measures what the PLATFORM does with model replies of a recorded shape. It is NOT a G0 result: no real ScientificLLM is invoked.
visible_to_the_system: the measurement report (or the case's evidence variant), the device file, the goal, the deployment's capability availability

metrics.considered: some admitted hypothesis makes a SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS prediction over the observable of a true cause (contact_discontinuity->sp.contact_connectivity, normalization_error->sp.normalization_basis, mesh_artifact->sp.mesh_stability, dopant_compensation->sp.carrier_profile, probe_artifact->sp.probe_contact_resistance); split by origin PRE_OBSERVATION / POST_SCREENING
metrics.decisive_executed: a check in decisive_cheap_checks ran (screening or verification), among cases where that check is available
metrics.false_abnormal: an ABNORMAL reading on an observable not in expected_abnormal_observables
metrics.false_confirmation: episode CONFIRMED on a hypothesis whose discriminating observables include no true cause's observable, or any confirmation of a POST_SCREENING hypothesis
metrics.post_screening_support: a SUPPORTS relation to a POST_SCREENING hypothesis
metrics.repeated_screened_reading: verification ran a capability screening already read on the same input
metrics.ineligible_screening: a screening Job for a SIMULATION/MEASUREMENT/FABRICATION capability or an UNAVAILABLE one
metrics.screening_checks: screening Jobs per case; NORMAL readings are counted as checks that changed nothing
metrics.leak: a case id, an evaluator rationale, a truth key or a benchmark note appears in any prompt sent to the model

acceptance_thresholds.structure: reported only: a prototype awaiting an Owner decision; no acceptance threshold
acceptance_thresholds.reproducibility: the dev split re-run under 'screening' yields identical normalized records

disclosures: The holdout author's hand-back message summarised each holdout case's truth to the implementer before this protocol and the stand-in were frozen. The stand-in's rules read only prompt contexts; its structure heuristics (via not drawn to metal, an overlap under half of the largest, a length basis more than 10% off) are generic and were not tuned on holdout results, but the holdout cannot be called unseen by the implementer.
Dev cases dv-01..dv-08 come from the VS-SP-001 benchmark the platform was developed against.
